description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application from Java 8 / Spring Boot 2.7.18 to Java 25 / Spring Boot 4.0+
tasks.reason: Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.x are end-of-life and prohibited for internal use per corporate policy (targets.md, charter.md). The organization mandates Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.0+ as the minimum compliant baseline for all supply chain services. The upgrade also migrates from javax.* to jakarta.* namespaces required by Spring Boot 4.0+.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project to Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.0+. This includes: updating the Java source/target compiler version to 25, upgrading the Spring Boot parent POM version to 4.0+, migrating all javax.* imports to jakarta.* equivalents (javax.persistence → jakarta.persistence, javax.validation → jakarta.validation), addressing any Spring Boot 4.x breaking changes in configuration and API usage, and ensuring the project compiles and all tests pass after the upgrade.

tasks.description: Migrate RabbitMQ AMQP messaging to Azure Service Bus with Managed Identity
tasks.reason: RabbitMQ is an on-premises message broker that must be replaced with Azure Service Bus as part of the Azure migration. RabbitMQ credentials are hardcoded in application.yml which violates corporate security guardrails. Azure Service Bus provides a fully managed, cloud-native messaging service.
tasks.requirements: Replace the spring-boot-starter-amqp dependency and RabbitTemplate usage in PurchaseOrderService and InventoryService with Azure Service Bus using Spring Cloud Azure Service Bus starter. Remove RabbitMQ queue bean definitions from AppConfig and the RabbitMQ connection configuration from application.yml. Configure Azure Service Bus with Managed Identity for passwordless authentication. Migrate all three queues (order.created, inventory.alert, approval.pending) to Azure Service Bus queues. Ensure the project compiles and all tests pass after migration.

tasks.description: Migrate MySQL password-based connection to Azure Database for MySQL with Managed Identity
tasks.reason: The application uses a password-based MySQL connection with hardcoded credentials (root/root) in application.yml, which violates corporate security guardrails. Azure Database for MySQL with Managed Identity provides secure, passwordless database access in compliance with the policies.
tasks.requirements: Replace the mysql-connector-java driver and password-based datasource configuration with the Spring Cloud Azure MySQL Managed Identity starter. Remove the hardcoded database username and password from application.yml. Configure the datasource to use Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server with Managed Identity (passwordless authentication). Ensure the project compiles and all tests pass after migration.

tasks.description: Migrate hardcoded credentials from application.yml and source code to Azure Key Vault
tasks.reason: Hardcoded credentials (database password, RabbitMQ password) in application.yml and any plaintext secrets in source code violate the corporate security guardrail 'Hardcoded credentials in application.yml, application.properties, environment variables, or source code'. All sensitive values must be stored in Azure Key Vault per policies.md.
tasks.requirements: Scan application.yml and all source files for hardcoded credentials, API keys, connection strings, and other sensitive values. Remove all such hardcoded values and store them in Azure Key Vault. Configure access to Azure Key Vault via the Spring Cloud Azure Key Vault starter with Managed Identity. Reference secrets from Key Vault in application configuration using the Azure Key Vault property source. Ensure the project compiles and all tests pass after migration.

tasks.description: Replace RestTemplate with ServiceMesh SDK for all service-to-service HTTP communication
tasks.reason: RestTemplate is prohibited by corporate guardrails because it bypasses the service mesh layer, which provides automatic circuit breaking, mTLS termination, distributed tracing, and canary routing. All service-to-service communication must go through the ServiceMesh SDK (com.acme.mesh.ServiceMesh) per policies.md.
tasks.requirements: Remove the RestTemplate bean from AppConfig and replace the RestTemplate injection and usage in VendorService.getVendorRatingFromExternalService with the ServiceMesh SDK (com.acme.mesh.ServiceMesh). Remove the spring-web RestTemplate dependency if it is no longer used. Ensure all HTTP calls to external services (e.g., vendor-rating-service) are routed through the ServiceMesh SDK. Ensure the project compiles and all tests pass after migration.

tasks.description: Replace SLF4J (@Slf4j) logging with InternalLogger across all service and controller classes
tasks.reason: SLF4J (Lombok @Slf4j) is prohibited by corporate guardrails because it lacks trace context integration. The approved logging framework is InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger), which injects trace IDs, team tags, and structured JSON for observability compliance.
tasks.requirements: Remove all @Slf4j annotations and the associated Lombok SLF4J logging from PurchaseOrderService, InventoryService, VendorService, PurchaseOrderController, VendorController, and InventoryController. Replace all log.info(), log.warn(), log.error(), log.debug() calls with the equivalent InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger) API. Remove any direct Logback or java.util.logging usage if present. Ensure the project compiles and all tests pass after migration.

tasks.description: Replace exception-based flow control with the Result<T> pattern in all service methods
tasks.reason: Throwing exceptions for business logic flow control and using try/catch blocks for flow control are prohibited per the P0-2024-0847 post-incident mandate. All business error handling must use the Result<T> pattern (com.acme.commons.Result) per policies.md and targets.md.
tasks.requirements: Replace all exception-based flow control in PurchaseOrderService (IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException, RuntimeException), InventoryService (RuntimeException), and VendorService (RuntimeException) with the Result<T> pattern (com.acme.commons.Result). Remove try/catch blocks used for swallowing or redirecting business logic exceptions. Update method signatures to return Result<T> where appropriate and update all callers (controllers) accordingly. Remove @ControllerAdvice global exception handlers for business exceptions if present. Ensure the project compiles and all tests pass after migration.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate all CVE vulnerabilities in project dependencies
tasks.reason: The project dependencies (Spring Boot 2.7.18 era, mysql-connector-java 8.0.33, etc.) may contain known CVE vulnerabilities. All CVE issues must be fixed as explicitly requested to ensure the application meets security compliance requirements.
tasks.requirements: Scan all Maven dependencies declared in pom.xml for known CVE vulnerabilities. Upgrade, replace, or exclude all vulnerable dependency versions to achieve a CVE-clean dependency set. Verify the project compiles and all unit tests pass after each remediation. Produce a final CVE report confirming zero critical/high/medium vulnerabilities.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Java 25 runtime and Maven build tool established by task 001-upgrade-java-springboot.

tasks.description: Update Dockerfile to use approved Microsoft OpenJDK 25 images for Azure Container Apps deployment
tasks.reason: The existing Dockerfile uses a legacy Java 8 base image (maven:3.8-openjdk-8 and eclipse-temurin:8-jre) which is incompatible with the upgraded Java 25 runtime. The approved base images per targets.md are mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu (build) and mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-distroless (runtime).
tasks.requirements: Update the existing Dockerfile to use mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu as the Maven build stage base image and mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-distroless as the runtime stage base image. Update the JAR artifact name to match the upgraded version. Ensure the containerized application starts correctly on port 8080.

tasks.description: Generate Bicep IaC to provision all Azure resources required for Azure Container Apps deployment
tasks.reason: Deploying the modernized SupplyChain Backend to Azure Container Apps requires provisioning of Azure Container Apps environment, Azure Container Registry, Azure Service Bus, Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server, and Azure Key Vault. Bicep IaC ensures repeatable, auditable infrastructure provisioning per the charter's replatform-to-ACA strategy.
tasks.requirements: Generate Bicep infrastructure-as-code files under the infra/ directory to provision: Azure Container Apps environment and container app, Azure Container Registry for Docker image storage, Azure Service Bus namespace with queues (order.created, inventory.alert, approval.pending), Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server, and Azure Key Vault for secrets management. Configure all resources with Managed Identity for secure, passwordless authentication. All resources must follow the organization's naming conventions and tagging policies.
